children.text: shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas
children.translated_text: From the peak of the eastern mountain

children.text: dkar gsal zla ba shar byung
children.translated_text: The bright white moon has risen.

children.text: ma skyes a ma'i zhal ras
children.translated_text: The face of the young maiden

children.text: yid la 'khor 'khor byas byung
children.translated_text: Has been circling round and round in my mind.

children.text: na ning btab pa'i ljang gzhon
children.translated_text: The young plant sown last year

children.text: da lo sog ma'i phon lcog
children.translated_text: Is this year a bush of dry stalks.

children.text: pho gzhon rgas pa'i lus po
children.translated_text: The body of a youth grown old

children.text: lho gzhu de las gyong ba
children.translated_text: Is more bent than a southern bow.

children.text: rang sems song ba'i mi de
children.translated_text: That person to whom my heart has gone,

children.text: gtan gyi mdun mar byung na
children.translated_text: If she became my lifelong companion,

children.text: rgya mtsho'i gting nas nor bu
children.translated_text: It would be like finding a jewel

children.text: lon pa de dang mnyam byung
children.translated_text: From the depths of the ocean.

children.text: 'gro zhor lam bu'i snying thub
children.translated_text: The bold-hearted one met on a casual walk,

children.text: lus dri zhim pa'i bu mo
children.translated_text: A sweet-scented maiden—

children.text: g.yu chung gru dkar brnyed nas
children.translated_text: Like finding a small white turquoise

children.text: skyur ba de dang 'dra byung
children.translated_text: And then having to give it back.

children.text: mi chen dpon po'i sras mo
children.translated_text: The daughter of a great lord—

children.text: khams 'bras mtshar la bltas na
children.translated_text: If one gazes at her wonderful complexion,

children.text: kham sdong mthon po'i rtse nas
children.translated_text: It is like from the top of a tall peach tree

children.text: 'bras bu smin pa 'dra byung
children.translated_text: Ripe fruit appearing.

children.text: sems pa phar la shor nas
children.translated_text: My thoughts having strayed far away,

children.text: mtshan mo'i gnyid thebs gcog gi
children.translated_text: They disturb my sleep at night;

children.text: nyin mo lag tu ma lon
children.translated_text: By day I cannot grasp them—

children.text: yid thang chad rogs yin pa
children.translated_text: They serve only to make me despondent.

children.text: me tog nam zla yal song
children.translated_text: The flower has faded with the season;

children.text: g.yu sbrang sems pa ma skyo
children.translated_text: Let the bee not be discouraged.

children.text: byams pa'i las 'phro zad par
children.translated_text: When the karmic connection of love is exhausted,

children.text: nga ni skyo rguy mi 'dug
children.translated_text: There is no reason for me to be sad.

children.text: rtsi thog ba mo'i kha la
children.translated_text: Upon the lips of the rose,

children.text: skya ser rlung gi pho nya
children.translated_text: The pale yellow messenger of the wind—

children.text: me tog sbrang bu gnyis kyi
children.translated_text: Between the flower and the bee

children.text: 'bral mtshams byed mkhan los yin
children.translated_text: It is surely the one that causes separation.

children.text: ngang pa 'dam la chags nas
children.translated_text: The swan, attached to the meadow,

children.text: re zhig sdod dgos bsams kyang
children.translated_text: Though thinking it should stay a while,

children.text: mtsho mo dar kha 'grigs nas
children.translated_text: The lake, spreading its silken surface—

children.text: rang sems kho thag chod song
children.translated_text: My heart has made its decision.

children.text: gru shan sems pa med kyang
children.translated_text: Though the crane has no such intention,

children.text: rta mgos phyi mig bltas byung
children.translated_text: It looked back over its shoulder like a horse turning its head.

children.text: khrel gzhung med pa'i byams pas
children.translated_text: But the shameless lover

children.text: nga la phyi mig mi lta
children.translated_text: Does not even glance at me.

children.text: nga dang tshong 'dus bu mo'i
children.translated_text: Between me and the marketplace girl,

children.text: tshig gsum dam bca'i mdud pa
children.translated_text: The three-word oath's knot—

children.text: khra bo'i sbrul la ma brgyab
children.translated_text: It was not tied on a spotted snake;

children.text: rang rang sa la grol song
children.translated_text: It came undone on its own.

children.text: chung 'dris byams pa'i rlung bskyed
children.translated_text: The stirring wind of childhood love

children.text: lcang ma'i logs la btsugs yod
children.translated_text: Has been planted by the willow's side.

children.text: lcang srung a jo zhal ngos
children.translated_text: Oh guardian of the willow, dear brother,

children.text: rdo ka rgyag pa ma gnang
children.translated_text: Please do not throw stones.

children.text: bris pa'i yi ge nag chung
children.translated_text: Written letters in black ink

children.text: chu dang thig pas 'jig song
children.translated_text: Are destroyed by water and raindrops.

children.text: ma bris sems kyi ri mo
children.translated_text: The unwritten picture of the heart

children.text: bsubs kyang zub rgyu mi 'dug
children.translated_text: Even if erased, cannot be wiped away.

children.text: rgyab pa'i nag chung the 'us
children.translated_text: The folded letter that was sent

children.text: gsung skad 'byon ni mi shes
children.translated_text: Does not know how to speak aloud.

children.text: khrel dang gzhung gi the 'u
children.translated_text: The message of modesty and propriety—

children.text: so so'i sems la skyon dang
children.translated_text: Let each ponder it in their own mind.

children.text: stong ldan ha lo'i me tog
children.translated_text: If a flower of the empty halo

children.text: mchod pa'i rdzas la phebs na
children.translated_text: Comes as an offering substance,

children.text: g.yu sbrang gzhon nu nga yang
children.translated_text: I, the young bee, too—

children.text: lha khang nang la khrid dang
children.translated_text: Lead me into the temple.

children.text: sems song bu mo mi bzhugs
children.translated_text: The girl to whom my heart has gone is not here;

children.text: dam pa'i chos la phebs na
children.translated_text: If she has gone to the sacred <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: pho gzhon nga yang mi sdod
children.translated_text: I, the young man, will not stay either—

children.text: ri khrod 'grim la thal 'gro
children.translated_text: I shall wander to mountain retreats.

children.text: mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du
children.translated_text: Before the qualified <s>lama</s>,

children.text: sems 'khrid zhu bar phyin pas
children.translated_text: I went to request mind-guidance,

children.text: sems pa 'gor kyang mi thub
children.translated_text: But I could not keep my mind from straying—

children.text: byams pa'i phyogs la shor song
children.translated_text: It slipped away toward my beloved.

children.text: sgom pa'i bla ma'i zhal ras
children.translated_text: The face of the meditation <s>lama</s>

children.text: yid la 'char rgyu mi 'dug
children.translated_text: Cannot arise in my mind,

children.text: ma sgom byams pa'i zhal ras
children.translated_text: But the un-meditated face of my beloved

children.text: yid la wa le wa le
children.translated_text: Appears vividly, again and again.

children.text: sems pa 'di la 'gro 'gro
children.translated_text: If the mind goes in this direction

children.text: dam pa'i chos la phyin na
children.translated_text: And proceeds to the sacred <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: tshe gcig lus gcig nyid la
children.translated_text: In this one life, in this one body,

children.text: sangs rgyas thob pa 'dug go
children.translated_text: Buddhahood can be attained.

children.text: dag pa shel ri gangs chu
children.translated_text: Pure crystal-mountain glacier water,

children.text: klu bdud rdo rje'i zil pa
children.translated_text: The dew-drops of the <s>nāga</s>-demon <s>Vajra</s>,

children.text: bdud rtsi sman gyi phab rgyun
children.translated_text: A flowing stream of ambrosia medicine—

children.text: chang ma ye shes mkha' 'gro
children.translated_text: The ale-woman is a wisdom <s>ḍākinī</s>.

children.text: dam tshig gtsang mas btung na
children.translated_text: If drunk with pure <s>samaya</s> (sacred vows),

children.text: ngan song myong dgos mi 'dug
children.translated_text: There is no need to experience the lower realms.

children.text: rlung rta yar 'gro'i dus la
children.translated_text: At the time of rising fortune,

children.text: rlung bskyed dar lcog btsugs pas
children.translated_text: Having raised wind-flags and prayer banners,

children.text: mdzangs ma ma bzang bu mo'i
children.translated_text: The clever, beautiful maiden's

children.text: mgron po la ni bos byung
children.translated_text: Guest has been summoned.

children.text: so dkar lpags pa'i 'dzum mdangs
children.translated_text: Her white-toothed, smooth-skinned, smiling radiance—

children.text: bzhugs gral spyi la bltas na
children.translated_text: If one looks at the whole assembly,

children.text: mig zur khra mo'i sgril mtshams
children.translated_text: Her sharp, darting eye-corner's glance

children.text: gzhpn pa'i gdong la bltas byung
children.translated_text: Fell upon the young man's face.

children.text: ha cang sems la song nas
children.translated_text: Having been so deeply taken by heart,

children.text: 'grogs 'dris e yong dris pas
children.translated_text: I asked, 'Will you be my companion?'

children.text: 'chi bral byed na min na
children.translated_text: 'Unless death separates us,'

children.text: gson bral mi byed gsungs byung
children.translated_text: 'I will not part from you in life,' she said.

children.text: mdzangs ma'i thugs dang bstun na
children.translated_text: If I follow the wise maiden's wishes,

children.text: tshe 'di'i chos skal chad 'gro
children.translated_text: My <s>Dharma</s> fortune in this life will be cut off.

children.text: dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims na
children.translated_text: If I wander to remote mountain retreats,

children.text: bu mo'i thugs dang 'gal gro
children.translated_text: I will go against the maiden's wishes.

children.text: sbrang bu rgya la bcug 'dra
children.translated_text: Like a bee trapped in a net,

children.text: kong phrug gzhon pa'i blo sna
children.translated_text: The young cuckoo's fickle mind—

children.text: zhag gsum nyal rogs byas pas
children.translated_text: After sharing a bed for three nights,

children.text: phugs yul lha chos dran byung
children.translated_text: It remembered the homeland and divine <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: gtan grogs khyod la bsams pa'i
children.translated_text: Thinking of you as a lifelong companion,

children.text: khrel dang ngo tsha med na
children.translated_text: If there were no modesty or shame,

children.text: mgo la rgyab pa'i gsug g.yus
children.translated_text: The turquoise ornament placed on the head

children.text: skad cha smras ni mi shes
children.translated_text: Does not know how to speak.

children.text: 'dzum dang so dkar ston phyogs
children.translated_text: The direction that shows smiles and white teeth

children.text: gzhon pa'i blo khrid yin 'dug
children.translated_text: Is what leads the young man's mind.

children.text: snying nas sha tsha yod med
children.translated_text: Whether you truly care from the heart,

children.text: dbu mna' bzhes rogs gnang dang
children.translated_text: Please take an oath upon it.

children.text: snying thub bya rdo lam 'phrad
children.translated_text: The bold one met by chance on the road—

children.text: a ma chang mas sbyar byung
children.translated_text: The ale-woman brought us together.

children.text: lan chags bu lon byung na
children.translated_text: If a karmic debt has arisen,

children.text: 'tsho skyong khyod ras gnang zhu
children.translated_text: I beseech you to care for and sustain it.

children.text: snying gtam pha mar ma bshad
children.translated_text: Do not tell heart-secrets outward;

children.text: chung 'dris byams par bshad pas
children.translated_text: Because I told my childhood sweetheart,

children.text: byams pa shwa pho mang nas
children.translated_text: Since the lover is among many like a stag,

children.text: gsang gtam dgra bos go song
children.translated_text: The secret was heard by enemies.

children.text: snying thub yid 'phrog lha mo
children.translated_text: The bold, mind-stealing goddess—

children.text: rngon pa rang gis zin kyang
children.translated_text: Though I, the hunter, caught her myself,

children.text: dbang chen mi yi dpon po
children.translated_text: The powerful lord of men,

children.text: nor bzang rgyal bus 'phrogs song
children.translated_text: The prince of fine wealth, snatched her away.

children.text: nor bu rang la yod dus
children.translated_text: When the jewel was in my possession,

children.text: nor bu'i nor nyams ma chod
children.translated_text: I did not appreciate the jewel's value.

children.text: nor bu mi la shor dus
children.translated_text: When the jewel was lost to another,

children.text: snying rlung stod la tshangs byung
children.translated_text: Heart-wind rose to my chest in anguish.

children.text: rang la dga' ba'i byams pa
children.translated_text: The beloved who loved me

children.text: gzhan la mdun mar blangs song
children.translated_text: Has been taken as another's companion.

children.text: khong nang sems pa'i gcong gis
children.translated_text: The grief of inner heartache

children.text: lus po'i sha yang bskams song
children.translated_text: Has dried even the flesh of my body.

children.text: snying thub rku la shor song
children.translated_text: The bold one has been lost to a thief;

children.text: mo phywa rtsis 'bul ran song
children.translated_text: It is time to offer a divination.

children.text: bu mo gdung sems can ma
children.translated_text: The girl of longing heart

children.text: rmi lam nang la 'khor song
children.translated_text: Has appeared in my dreams.

children.text: bu mor 'chi ba med pa
children.translated_text: If the maiden were immortal

children.text: chang la 'dzad pa mi 'dug
children.translated_text: And the ale never ran out,

children.text: gzhon pa'i gtan gyi skyabs gnas
children.translated_text: As a youth's lasting refuge,

children.text: 'di la bcol bas los chog
children.translated_text: This could surely be relied upon.

children.text: bu mo a mar ma skyes
children.translated_text: The girl was not born from a mother;

children.text: kham bu'i shing la skyes sam
children.translated_text: Was she born from a peach tree?

children.text: a gsar zad pa kham bu'i
children.translated_text: Her freshness fades like a peach

children.text: me tog de las mgyogs pa
children.translated_text: Blossom, even faster.

children.text: bu mo chung 'dris byams pa
children.translated_text: The girl, my childhood sweetheart—

children.text: spyang ki'i rigs rgyud min nam
children.translated_text: Is she not of the lineage of wolves?

children.text: sha 'dris lpags 'dris byung yang
children.translated_text: Though she became intimate with flesh and skin,

children.text: ri la yar grabs mdzad kyis
children.translated_text: She prepared to flee up to the mountains.

children.text: rta rgod ri la rgyab pa
children.translated_text: A wild horse sent to the mountains

children.text: rnyi dang zhags pas zin gyis
children.translated_text: Can be caught with halter and lasso,

children.text: byams pa ngo log rgyab pa
children.translated_text: But a lover who turns her back—

children.text: mthu ngo zin pa mi 'dug
children.translated_text: There is no power that can catch her.

children.text: brag dang rlung po bsdebs nas
children.translated_text: When rock and wind come together,

children.text: rgod po'i sgro la gzan byung
children.translated_text: The eagle's feathers are damaged.

children.text: gyo can rdzu bag can gyis
children.translated_text: The deceitful, cunning one

children.text: nga la gzan po byas byung
children.translated_text: Has done me harm.

children.text: sprin pa kha ser gting nag
children.translated_text: Clouds yellow on top and dark beneath

children.text: sad dang se ra'i gzhi ma
children.translated_text: Are the foundation of frost and hail.

children.text: ban de skya min ser min
children.translated_text: A monk neither gray-robed nor yellow-robed

children.text: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo
children.translated_text: Is the enemy of the <s>Buddha</s>'s teaching.

children.text: sa de kha zhu gting 'khyags
children.translated_text: That ground, thawed on top and frozen beneath,

children.text: rta pho gtong sa ma red
children.translated_text: Is not a place to send a stallion.

children.text: gsar 'grogs byams pa'i phyogs su
children.translated_text: Toward a new lover's direction,

children.text: snying gtam bshad sa ma red
children.translated_text: Is not a place to tell heart-secrets.

children.text: tshes chen bco lnga'i zla ba
children.translated_text: The full moon of the fifteenth day

children.text: yin pa 'dra ba 'dug ste
children.translated_text: Seemed to be so, but

children.text: zla ba'i dkyil gyi ri bong
children.translated_text: The rabbit in the middle of the moon

children.text: tshe zad tshar nas 'dug go
children.translated_text: Has reached the end of its lifespan.

children.text: zla ba 'di nas phar 'gro
children.translated_text: This moon goes yonder;

children.text: rting ma'i zla ba tshur yong
children.translated_text: The next moon comes hither.

children.text: bkra shis zla ba dkar po'i
children.translated_text: The auspicious white moon—

children.text: zla stod phyogs la mjal yong
children.translated_text: In its first half, we shall meet again.

children.text: dbus kyi ri gyal lhun po
children.translated_text: The central king of mountains, <s>Sumeru</s>,

children.text: ma 'gyur brtan par bzhugs dang
children.translated_text: May you remain unchanged and stable.

children.text: nyi ma zla ba'i bskor phyogs
children.translated_text: The orbit of the sun and moon—

children.text: nor yong bsam pa mi 'dug
children.translated_text: There is no thought it could go wrong.

children.text: tshes gsum zla ba dkar ba
children.translated_text: The white moon of the third day

children.text: dkar gos nang na chod song
children.translated_text: Has been hidden within white garments.

children.text: bco lnga'i nam dang mnyam pa'i
children.translated_text: A promise equal to the sky of the fifteenth—

children.text: zhal bzhes cig kyang gnang zhu
children.translated_text: Please grant even one such vow.

children.text: sa bcu'i dbyings su bzhugs pa'i
children.translated_text: Abiding in the expanse of the ten <s>bhūmis</s> (bodhisattva stages),

children.text: dam can rdo rje chos skyong
children.translated_text: The oath-bound <s>Vajra Dharma</s> protector—

children.text: mthu dang nus pa yod na
children.translated_text: If you have power and ability,

children.text: bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol dang
children.translated_text: Please liberate the enemies of the teaching.

children.text: khu byug mon nas yong bas
children.translated_text: Because the cuckoo came from <s>Mön</s> (the south),

children.text: gnam lo'i sa bcud 'phel song
children.translated_text: The earth's essence of the year has increased.

children.text: nga dang byams pa phrad nas
children.translated_text: Since I met my beloved,

children.text: lus sems lhod por langs song
children.translated_text: My body and mind have become at ease.

children.text: skye 'gro mi rtag 'chi ba
children.translated_text: If one says that beings are impermanent and that death

children.text: snying nas ma dran zer na
children.translated_text: Is not truly remembered from the heart,

children.text: spyang grung 'dzoms mdog kha yang
children.translated_text: Even the fox with its clever appearance

children.text: don la lkugs pa 'dra byung
children.translated_text: Is in truth no better than a mute.

children.text: khyi de stag khyi gzig khyi
children.translated_text: That dog—a tiger-dog, a leopard-dog—

children.text: ldag kha ster nas 'dris song
children.translated_text: Was tamed by giving it licks.

children.text: nang gi stag mo ral 'dzoms
children.translated_text: But the inner tigress with flowing mane,

children.text: 'dris nas mthu ru langs song
children.translated_text: Once tamed, rose up in fierce power.

children.text: sha 'jam lus po 'dris kyang
children.translated_text: Though I became intimate with her soft body,

children.text: byams pa'i gdeng tshod mi lon
children.translated_text: I cannot be confident of the lover's heart.

children.text: sa la ri mo bris pas
children.translated_text: Having drawn a diagram on the ground,

children.text: nam mkha'i skar tshod thig byung
children.translated_text: The measure of the stars in the sky was obtained.

children.text: nga dang byams pa'i sdebs sa
children.translated_text: The meeting place of me and my beloved

children.text: lho rong ljon pa'i nags gseb
children.translated_text: Is in the southern valley's wooded grove.

children.text: smra mkhan ne tso ma gtogs
children.translated_text: Apart from the speaking parrot,

children.text: su dang gang gis mi shes
children.translated_text: No one at all knows.

children.text: smra mkhan ne tso o shes
children.translated_text: Oh speaking parrot, know this:

children.text: gsang kha mdo la ma gnang
children.translated_text: Do not reveal the secret at the crossroads.

children.text: lha sa mi tshogs mthug la
children.translated_text: In <s>Lhasa</s> where crowds are thick,

children.text: 'phyongs rgyas mi spus dag pa
children.translated_text: The pure people of <s>Chongye</s>—

children.text: nga la yod pa'i chung 'dris
children.translated_text: The childhood companion I have

children.text: 'phyongs rgyas gzhung la yod do
children.translated_text: Is in the land of <s>Chongye</s>.

children.text: khyi rgan rgya bo zer ba
children.translated_text: The old dog called 'the Chinaman'—

children.text: rnam shes mi las spyang ba
children.translated_text: Its consciousness is sharper than a human's.

children.text: srod la langs song ma zer
children.translated_text: Do not say I went out in the evening;

children.text: tho rangs log byung ma zer
children.translated_text: Do not say I returned at dawn.

children.text: srod la byams pa btsal bas
children.translated_text: Because I went seeking my beloved in the evening,

children.text: tho rangs kha ba bab byung
children.translated_text: At dawn, snow had fallen.

children.text: gsang dang ma gsang mi 'dug
children.translated_text: There is no way to keep it secret;

children.text: zhabs rjes gangs la bzhag yod
children.translated_text: My footprints have been left in the snow.

children.text: po ta la ru bzhugs dus
children.translated_text: When residing in the <s>Potala</s>,

children.text: rig 'dzin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho
children.translated_text: I am <s>Rigdzin Tsangyang Gyatso</s>,

children.text: lha sa zhol du sdod dus
children.translated_text: When staying in the <s>Zhol</s> of <s>Lhasa</s>,

children.text: 'chal po dwangs bzang dbang po
children.translated_text: I am the dissolute youth <s>Dangzang Wangpo</s>.

children.text: sha 'jam mal sa nang gi
children.translated_text: In the soft bed,

children.text: snying thub gdung sems can ma
children.translated_text: Is the bold one, the longing-hearted maiden.

children.text: o lo'i rgyu nor 'phrog pa'i
children.translated_text: The wealth that is the cause of the young one's

children.text: gyo sgyu bshad pa min 'gro
children.translated_text: deception need not be explained;

children.text: dbu zwa dbu la bzhes song
children.translated_text: the hat was placed upon the head,

children.text: dbu lcang rgyab la dbyugs song
children.translated_text: the braids were tossed behind the back.

children.text: ga ler phebs shig byas pas
children.translated_text: When I said 'Please go somewhere,'

children.text: ga ler bzhugs shig gsung gis
children.translated_text: she replied, 'Please stay somewhere.'

children.text: thugs sems skyo yong byas pas
children.translated_text: When I said 'Your heart will grow sad,'

children.text: mgyogs po 'phrad yong gsungs byung
children.translated_text: she replied, 'We shall meet again soon.'

children.text: bya de khrung khrung dkar mo
children.translated_text: O that bird, the white crane —

children.text: nga la gshog rtsal g.yar dang
children.translated_text: lend me your wings!

children.text: thag ring rgyang la mi 'gro
children.translated_text: I shall not go far away;

children.text: li thang bskor nas slebs yong
children.translated_text: having circled <s>Lithang</s>, I shall return.

children.text: shi de dmyal ba'i yul gyi
children.translated_text: In the realm of the dead, in the land of hell,

children.text: chos rgyal las kyi me long
children.translated_text: the mirror of <s>karma</s> (deeds) of <s>Dharmarāja</s> (Lord of Death) —

children.text: 'di na khrig khrig mi 'dug
children.translated_text: it does not deceive here,

children.text: de nas khrig khrig gnang zhu
children.translated_text: it will not deceive there either.

children.text: mda' mo 'ben la phog song
children.translated_text: The arrow has struck the target;

children.text: mde'u sa la 'dzul song
children.translated_text: the bullet has entered the ground;

children.text: chung 'dris byams pa 'phrad byung
children.translated_text: I have met the beloved of my youth,

children.text: sems nyid rjes la 'brangs song
children.translated_text: and my heart has followed after.

children.text: rgya gar shar gyi rma bya
children.translated_text: The peacock of eastern India

children.text: kong yul mthil gyi ne tso
children.translated_text: and the cuckoo of the heart of <s>Kong-yul</s> —

children.text: 'khrungs sa 'khrungs yul mi gcig
children.translated_text: though their birthplaces are different,

children.text: 'dzoms sa chos 'khor lha sa
children.translated_text: their meeting place is <s>Lhasa</s>, the seat of the <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: mi tshos nga la lab pa
children.translated_text: What people say about me —

children.text: dgongs su dag pa khag theg
children.translated_text: it is difficult to bear as pure in intention.

children.text: o lo'i gom gsum phra mo
children.translated_text: The young one's three small steps

children.text: gnas mo'i nang la thal song
children.translated_text: have gone into the beloved's dwelling.

children.text: lcang ma byi 'ur sems shor
children.translated_text: My heart was lost to the willow's little bird,

children.text: byi 'u lcang mar sems shor
children.translated_text: the little bird's heart was lost to the willow;

children.text: sems shor mthun pa byung na
children.translated_text: if the lost hearts are in accord,

children.text: skya khra hor pas mi thub
children.translated_text: the magpie-hawk cannot overcome [their bond].

children.text: da lta'i tshe thung 'di la
children.translated_text: In this present short life,

children.text: de kha tsam zhig zhus nas
children.translated_text: having asked only that much,

children.text: rting ma byis pa'i lo la
children.translated_text: in the next life, in the years of youth,

children.text: mjal 'dzom e yong blta 'o
children.translated_text: let us see whether we shall meet again.

children.text: bya de smra mkhan ne tso
children.translated_text: That bird, the talking cuckoo —

children.text: kha rog bzhugs rogs mdzod dang
children.translated_text: please remain as a companion, I ask;

children.text: lcang gling a lce 'jol mo
children.translated_text: the nightingale of the willow grove

children.text: gsung snyan skyur dgos byas byung
children.translated_text: has said she must return her sweet song.

children.text: rgyab kyi klu bdud btsan po
children.translated_text: The powerful <s>nāga</s>-demon behind —

children.text: 'jigs dang mi 'jigs mi 'dug
children.translated_text: there is no fear or fearlessness;

children.text: mdun gyu ka ra ku shu
children.translated_text: the turquoise garden and apple tree before —

children.text: 'thogs su dgos pa byas song
children.translated_text: were made into an obstacle.

children.text: dang po ma mthong chog pa
children.translated_text: Not having seen her at first

children.text: sems pa shor don mi 'dug
children.translated_text: would have been no reason to lose one's heart;

children.text: gnyis pa ma 'dris chog pa
children.translated_text: not having become acquainted the second time

children.text: sems gcong yong don mi 'dug
children.translated_text: would have been no reason for heartache.
